description: Amacı Mars'ın mevsimsel sıcaklık ve atmosfer basıncı değişimlerini incelemek Dünya'daki benzer bölgeleri belirlemek ve farklı etkenleri kıyaslayarak bu bölgelerden en uygun olanına bir araştırma üssü kurulması için sitesi kurmaktır. Gezegenin koşullarını yerinde incelemek hem teknolojik açıdan zor hem de maliyetlidir. Bu nedenle biz de Dünya üzerinde Mars'ın mevsimsel sıcaklık ve atmosfer basıncı değişimlerine benzer olan analog bölgelerikoşulların detaylıca incelenebileceği bir site kurmaktır.
summary: "Earth's Twins of Mars" is an interactive 3D simulation platform that compares Mars' Gale Crater with three analog sites on Earth (McMurdo Dry Valleys, Snake River Plain, and Sandvatn Lake Basin) under identical seasonal and local solar conditions. Because studying Mars directly is difficult, our tool helps identify the best Earth location for analog bases—highlighting the McMurdo Dry Valleys—to enable low-cost equipment testing and astronaut training while reducing mission delay risks. Grounded in NASA/JPL and peer-reviewed data, the platform lets users explore 7 core environmental parameters with transparent confidence levels, delivering a reliable digital twin experience.
details: The "Earth's Twins of Mars" project is an interactive 3D simulation and analysis platform that compares Mars' Gale Crater side-by-side with three analog sites on Earth (McMurdo Dry Valleys, Snake River Plain, and Sandvatn Lake Basin). What it does & How it works: Users can select an Earth analog site, adjust the hour and season, and examine environmental parameters such as pressure, temperature, boiling point, and radiation side-by-side with NASA/JPL Gale Crater data in an interactive 3D environment. Benefits & Intended Impact: It serves as a valuable planning tool for future crewed Mars research bases, helping researchers understand environmental risks, while also providing an accessible, interactive educational platform for students and science enthusiasts. Tools, Technologies & AI Disclosure: Developed using Lovable, modern web technologies, and NASA/JPL Curiosity REMS & RAD datasets. AI-assisted development tools (Lovable) were utilized to build and structure the interactive web interface, and AI language models assisted with code and text structuring. Creativity & Key Factors Considered by the Team: The project stands out by bridging real NASA planetary data with Earth-based analog environments in an accessible, web-based 3D framework. During development, our team prioritized scientific accuracy, user experience (UX), and the effective visualization of complex environmental datasets.
